run_recipes.title: mRNABench Sample designed MRL baselines on CPU
run_recipes.summary: Evaluate SequenceComposition RidgeCV and training-mean controls on the pinned mRNABench Sample designed 5' UTR MRL canonical 70,011/15,003/15,003 seed-2541 split using released rewirebench 0.6.2.
inputs: morrislab/mrl-sample mrl-sample-designed.parquet at revision ef67f7cf8a999bb1c412ad6551aa7d9f901cbb95 (SHA-256 verified during recipe fetch, 100,017 sequences; canonical 15,003-record test split).
outputs: Per-baseline report.json and predictions.json with MSE, Pearson, Spearman, coverage and unscored counts.
Verified receipt.json and SHA256SUMS written locally; nothing is submitted automatically.

requirements.data: Pinned mrl-sample-designed.parquet fetched from morrislab/mrl-sample on Hugging Face with SHA-256 verified.
requirements.weights: No neural network weights; procedural controls fit training labels only.
requirements.licence: Runner and recipe are MIT; upstream morrislab/mrl-sample dataset source licence is unreported.
requirements.software: Python 3.11 or newer with released rewirebench[sequence] 0.6.2 from PyPI.
requirements.hardware: CPU execution (measured 14.764 s wall time and 1.01 GB peak RSS on Apple M4 arm64).

instructions.title: Run the two-baseline mRNABench designed MRL recipe with released rewirebench 0.6.2
instructions.code:
curl --fail --location --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rewire-bio/rewire-benchmarks/37cf4634f57d1d54619794f62d9b954186a864c6/recipes/mrnabench/mrnabench-designed-mrl-baselines.yaml
echo "a025843c19a25d7eb6470c0abef0994da074929f8ad392d7ca4d9c1e7954e996  mrnabench-designed-mrl-baselines.yaml" | shasum -a 256 --check
uvx --from "rewirebench[sequence]==0.6.2" rewirebench recipe run mrnabench-designed-mrl-baselines.yaml --output runs/mrnabench-designed-mrl
uvx --from "rewirebench[sequence]==0.6.2" rewirebench receipt verify runs/mrnabench-designed-mrl --strict

validation_receipt.source_locator: receipt.json and per-baseline report.json files (11/11 recipe checks and 6 metric checks passed across 2 baselines)

limitations: Rerun with the project's own baseline implementation and pinned parquet source, not an independent reproduction by another group.
Evaluates SequenceComposition RidgeCV and training-mean controls only; does not evaluate pretrained RNA foundation models or represent benchmark-wide mRNABench performance.
